query: How can GST registration be canceled in Tamil Nadu?
reference_answer:
GST Registration Cancellation:
For GST registration cancellation in Tamil Nadu, file Form GST REG-16 on the GST portal (gst.gov.in). Provide reasons for cancellation and supporting documents. The tax officer will verify and cancel the registration.
answer: GST registration can be canceled in Tamil Nadu by filing a formal application with the State GST Portal or local revenue office. Ensure all dues are settled before cancellation. [Document N] not available for detailed steps.
